title: T74: implement a conditional O(V d^0.998305) physical layer
body:
I implement PR2979's complete T74 complex caller and normalized physical root, including both providers, native warps and checked release of 91 private zero buffers. I bind all 666 calls and 2,222 global events to their actual owner charts and preserve the complete positive-child histogram.

Under the retained native, hosting and ordinary B1/C0 interfaces, on the specified spaced-axis/long-record domain, I derive

```text
O(V d^0.99830289 (log(2d))^0.99830289) = O(V d^0.998305).
```

The resulting layer saving is 0.001695, compared with PR3385's 1/600 target. I recount the actual scalar passes, private storage, numerical-height guard and root reservations. I introduce no runtime-coefficient assumption from the 2048-bit prefix reserve.

Verification covers 14 checks across three cold commands:

- Both fresh five-stage native chains, seven proof-relevant artifact identities, four full compilations and four complete modular endpoint probes.
- All 420,912 owner entries, four production dispatch variants, 3,782 affine monomials and 2,248 phase signatures, including encoded tensor-phase checks.
- Reduced recursive execution with ten child calls/returns, nonzero-private-release rejection, and normalized direct/fast root returns. The fast root includes five child calls/returns.
- Exact scalar, tape, height and moment bounds. Metadata, immutable bytes and declared-source history pass at head `75343dd7e067c40d18c243ea97231b7006680eef` for 30 files.

Reproduce with Python 3.12 and numpy 2.2.6:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t74-physical-layer
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/t74-physical-layer --check-source-history
```

GitHub completed the [hosted replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39092758401) with success, including the committed-input immutability check.

I retain the source-relative native, ordinary-backend and hosting hypotheses. Modular probes and reduced physical fixtures do not prove universal complex equality. I have not executed the production O73/GL64 payload or obtained independent human/full formal-kernel review. The enclosing multiplication embedding, error budget and integer packing remain open; I claim no new integer kappa and leave the selected frontier unchanged.

I start from current main `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6. The two immutable archives make the code and declared dependencies available in a clean checkout without unmerged Git objects. Package docs preserve the source qualifications and notices. [Canonical claim and findings](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-19009513).

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance including source-analysis agents. I retain Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979, Nick Petalas/PR3342/3442/3453, Cinna Davis's borrowing/free-warp mechanism, Sagar Thakrar/PR3464, and the complete compiler, geometry, owner, ordinary and numerical lineage in NOTICE.md.
